nodes.description: POOH token contract reference stored in the Lottery contract
Owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by onlyOwner
Boolean flag controlling whether the lottery accepts deposits
Current ticket counter, incremented on each deposit
Randomly generated winning ticket derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty
Constructor: sets poohContract, openToPublic=false and owner=msg.sender
Empty payable fallback that accepts ETH from anyone
Main payable entrypoint: buys POOH, tracks tickets, triggers payouts and reset
View returning the lottery's POOH token balance
View returning the lottery's POOH dividends
View returning the contract's ETH balance
Owner-only function that opens the lottery and resets it
Owner-only recovery function that transfers arbitrary ERC20 tokens out
Internal function that computes balance and transfers ETH to the winner
Internal function that transfers 10% of the balance to the dev/owner
Internal function resetting ticketNumber and drawing a new winningNumber
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner
Modifier rejecting token transfers to the POOH contract address
Modifier requiring the openToPublic flag to be true
Modifier requiring msg.sender == tx.origin (EOA-only check)
msg.sender: caller address used for ownership, deposits and payouts
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used for randomness
tx.origin: transaction origin used in the onlyHuman modifier
winner.transfer(balance): external ETH transfer to an attacker-controlled address before state reset
dev.transfer(balance): external ETH transfer executed before the lottery is reset
poohContract.buy.value(msg.value)(customerAddress): external payable call forwarding user funds
poohContract.exit(): external call that sells all POOH tokens
poohContract.buy.value(address(this).balance)(customerAddress): spends the whole contract balance
ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(tokenOwner, tokens): external token transfer with user-supplied token address
ticketNumber += extraTickets: unchecked counter arithmetic
ticketNumber++: increment of the ticket counter
winningNumber = uint256(keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty))%300: predictable timestamp-based randomness
SafeMath.sub(address(this).balance, 50000000000000000): balance computation guarded by assert
SafeMath.div(msg.value, 1000000000000000): division computing extra ticket count
SafeMath.div(address(this).balance, 10): division computing the dev fee
winner parameter of payWinner, source of the outgoing ETH transfer
dev parameter of payDev, recipient of the dev fee
tokenAddress parameter of returnAnyERC20Token, target ERC20 contract
tokenOwner parameter of returnAnyERC20Token, recipient of recovered tokens
tokens parameter of returnAnyERC20Token, amount to transfer
aContract parameter of the notPooh modifier checked against poohContract
deposit local: address customerAddress = msg.sender, used as deposit beneficiary and winner
deposit local: extraTickets computed from msg.value for the ticket counter
payWinner local: balance = contract balance minus 0.05 ETH reserve
payDev local: balance = 10% of the contract balance

normalization_plan.reason: The winner parameter is a temporary formal of payWinner and only exists to feed the internal payout routine.
The dev parameter is a temporary formal of payDev and disappears once merged into the dev payment routine.
tokenAddress is only the ABI formal selecting the ERC20 target inside returnAnyERC20Token.
tokenOwner is only the ABI recipient formal of returnAnyERC20Token.
tokens is only the ABI amount formal of returnAnyERC20Token.
aContract exists solely as the guarded argument of the notPooh modifier.
customerAddress is a deposit-scoped alias of msg.sender used for the POOH buy and winner payout.
extraTickets is an intermediate value consumed only by the ticketNumber += extraTickets operation.
The payWinner balance local is computed solely to be the argument of winner.transfer.
The payDev balance local is computed solely to be the argument of dev.transfer.
